evidence: Modifies PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages() in src/net_processing.cpp, the core P2P message transmission pipeline.
rationale: Extracts 17 move-only helper functions from the monolithic ~500-line SendMessages() method to improve code navigation and reviewability. While helpful for maintainability as noted by reviewers, it is an internal reorganization that does not retire a known protocol hazard or alter network behavior.
